outbound_post.purpose: 发布前内容测量与发布硬闸

outbound_reply.purpose: 我方回复发布前测量、真实性闸与响应对齐
outbound_reply.success_gate: engine manifest.complete=true。reply_alignment 是按需诊断(cce-submit.yml 的 with_alignment, 默认关), 不参与通过判定 —— 同稿重跑 3/8 翻转、|Δ|≈θ, 自身口径为「不作放行/拦截依据」; 关着跑时 reply_alignment_pass=null 属正常关闭态

subject_chain.purpose: 真实触达成员响应测量与下游窗口审计
required: subject_chain + response_source, inline or repository path with sha256
subject_chain.success_gate: all response s1 measurements valid; business VERIFIED remains evidence-dependent

media_ingest.purpose: 多模态解析产物入本体 —— 产出 Foundation observations 与 events(P3)
media_ingest.★input_is_parse_artifact: 本档的 `text` 是 **cce_video_parse 的解析产物 JSON**, 不是待发内容。理由: 解析需要 ffmpeg/OCR/ASR 与真实媒体文件, 不该塞进 CI; 而测量链要的是精确输入哈希与可回放 —— 产物走既有管道, text_sha256 天然就是那个哈希。
media_ingest.★no_guard_no_media_declaration: 不要 guard_profile(没有稿子要过合规闸), 也不要 media_declaration(它**本身就是**媒体那条路, 要求它声明自己有没有媒体是循环)。
media_ingest.★stops_at_foundation: 链止于 Foundation 层。测量是 P0–P2 的事, 走既有 profile —— 在这里重跑一遍就是重复测量。
media_ingest.★extraction_quality_unmeasured: 抽取质量(ASR/OCR 准确率)**未测**, 由 qualified_readout 具名扣发 —— observation 里的文字可作证据引用, 不得当作已验收的转写。
media_ingest.★scope_video_and_image: 收**视频解析产物**与**静态图片解析产物**。2026-08-15 已否决「静态图片与视频帧各建一套视觉合同」, 正确做法是「视频帧应是 MediaAsset + temporal selector 的 VisualObservation」⇒ 静态图是 selector 退化为 whole 的**同一种东西**, 走同一条链、同一份合同。★ 2026-09-04 图片档已晋升 production_github(CI run 33840200869 全链回放 complete=true + 本机真实素材 6/6), 原来那句「standalone_image_ingest 仍 missing ⇒ 不得声称图片全链可用」已被实测取代。

fingerprint_policy.scope: UTF-8 bytes of the exact submitted text
fingerprint_policy.rule: any text change requires a new fingerprint and a new submission_id/job_id

platform_context_model.platform: stable platform id backed by config/platform_adapter_registry_v1.json
platform_context_model.platform_adapter: versioned protocol normalizer; never includes a community id
platform_context_model.surface: time-bound runtime context such as subreddit/channel/group/profile/thread
platform_context_model.domain: runtime scene/category context, not an adapter identity
platform_context_model.rule: changing r/HearingAids to another valid subreddit changes only surface.id and its snapshot time

universal_context_model.record: each declared dimension carries value, assertion and evidence_refs; the snapshot also carries observed_at and provenance
universal_context_model.rule: platform/surface/domain are one platform scene inside Universal Context, not the whole Context model

outbound_guard_model.rule: domain capability is validated by a guard profile and never by the platform adapter

audience_policy.production_status: not a prerequisite of outbound_post CCE measurement
audience_policy.reason: community/audience is a dynamic subject/context window and must not be frozen into the platform adapter
audience_policy.legacy_research: s5/s6 may consume a separately frozen corpus for a declared experiment; s7/s8 remain research-only

output_contract.per_item_artifact: engine outputs plus manifest carrying submission/job/content/profile ids and SHA-256
output_contract.aggregate_artifact: workflow-manifest.json with per-item states; subject_chain also emits subject-window and end-to-end audits
